item.title: Pundit Says Triple-Digit XRP by Year-End Was “the Most Stupid” Call to Make
item.description: An XRP community pundit has challenged previous suggestions that XRP could reach triple digits this year, calling the prediction "stupid." Notably, 2025 has come to an end, and XRP is on the verge of closing the year with a 10% decline, which would make this its first bearish annual close since 2022. Interestingly, this discouraging performance, which began in the fourth quarter, contrasts with the crypto asset's price action earlier in the year.Visit Website
